remarks: DOUBLE THE UNITS, DOUBLE THE OPPORTUNITY at 28 Burch Ave! Whether you're looking to expand your investment portfolio or explore the benefits of owner-occupancy, this West Seneca two-family home offers income potential in a convenient location. Situated just off Seneca Street, with easy access to local restaurants, shopping, parks, and everyday amenities, this upper/lower property features two spacious units, each offering 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom. Both units are currently occupied, generating a combined $2,300 in monthly rental income ($27,600 annually), with separate utilities adding to the property's investment appeal. The lower unit features convenient first-floor in-unit laundry, central air conditioning, newer appliances, flooring, vanity, light fixtures, and updated electrical with GFCI, while the upper unit offers a gas hookup in the rear bedroom with the potential to accommodate a gas dryer, newer luxury vinyl plank flooring, kitchen cabinets, countertop, tub surround, toilet, vanity, light fixtures/ceiling fans, doors, and updated electrical with GFCI. There is a bonus room off of the stairwell to the upper unit for additional storage. Additional highlights include a fully fenced yard, a well-maintained 2-car garage that allows for off-street parking and additional storage, plus a partial basement. With established rental income, desirable amenities, and a location close to everything West Seneca and South Buffalo have to offer, this property presents an excellent opportunity for investors seeking an income-producing asset or future owner-occupants looking to offset their housing expenses with rental income. An open house is being offered on Saturday, October 17th, from noon - 2pm. Start building equity while your investment works for you at 28 Burch Ave.
